ask:
Lane brief: a verify skill that drives the real thing, claude-settings hooks first.
Governing: rule verification-green-proves-only-its-fixtures. Harm: lanes such as the standing-merge-role hook lane are proven by fixture tests alone.
1. test-author first: a case that starts a fresh cloud container's session-start hook and reads the recorded merge role; red on a build without the hook.
2. builder: write the skill for claude-settings hooks only. Other repos follow as their own steps.
3. reviewer.
Proof command: the skill's own run through `~/.claude/bin/verdict` in a fresh clone. Report cap: 25 lines. Prior work: PR 3639 (the hook this skill would have proven).
